Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the visual evidence from the English Wikipedia page it was viewing. The screenshot explicitly showed the text "Died 4 August 1995 (aged 82) Rome, Lazio, Italy". However, the agent's subsequent analysis claimed there was conflicting information stating the director died in "Los Angeles, California, USA". This specific claim of Los Angeles appears to be a hallucination or a misinterpretation of the data, as the Wikipedia page shown in the viewport clearly stated Rome, and other reliable sources (IMDb, Italian Wikipedia) also pointed to Rome. By introducing an incorrect location (Los Angeles) that contradicted the visible evidence and other sources, the WebSurfer agent created a false conflict that hindered the resolution of the task.
